criterion: Full-frame photographic subjects with distinctive visible object cues. Search/category/title are proposals only. Exclude paintings, scans, maps, line art, isolated object fragments, tiny/incidental targets, mixed/unclear subjects and uncertain protected cover/page reproductions. UNKNOWN negatives remain outside eight-name answer scope; their names are not trained. No images admitted automatically by search metadata or model prediction.
limits: All 644 proposals were visually reviewed, not independently blindly labelled. Individual source-photo permissions/attributions retained, not blanket clearance of every depicted design or alias/session independence. Original full-resolution bytes were not acquired. Complete coverage must pass before this new set can be used for a training/final iteration. Old final and prior author/photo exclusions remain unchanged. Canonical vocabulary statuses are not upgraded by collecting media. Negative source categories remain acquisition proposals: UNKNOWN means outside eight-name scope, not recognition of these negative names (for example plate/toilet-bowl/spoon-and-fork images do not teach bowl/fork).
